resources.title: Allston Brighton · hot meal & groceries
resources.food_offer: Freshly prepared hot takeout meal and a bag of groceries.
resources.eligibility: Provider welcomes everyone; no proof of need required.
resources.schedule_note: Published Wednesday distribution: 3–6 PM. Confirm holiday changes with the provider.

resources.title: Allston-Brighton Community Fridge
resources.food_offer: Self-service donated food and pantry items. Contents vary; a prepared meal is not guaranteed.
resources.eligibility: Provider describes self-service access for the community.
resources.schedule_note: Provider lists 24/7 access. Stock and fridge operation are not monitored.

resources.title: Allston Brighton · grocery pickup
resources.food_offer: Fresh groceries for cooking; pantry baskets also have a separate Saturday schedule.
resources.eligibility: Provider welcomes everyone; no proof of need required.
resources.schedule_note: Wednesday 3–6 PM. Saturday pickup times must be checked with the provider.

resources.title: Friday Night Supper · free prepared dinner
resources.food_offer: Prepared dinner service; soup and drinks are also described. Exact menu changes.
resources.eligibility: Everyone welcome. Provider says no registration or sign-up is required.
resources.schedule_note: Published Friday service: 5–7 PM, lower level of Arlington Street Church. Confirm changes before travel.
